title: Arterial partial pressure of oxygen (PaO2)

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: This value measures the pressure of oxygen dissolved in your blood. It helps show how well your lungs move oxygen from the air into your blood when you breathe in.
context: It is part of an arterial blood gas test and is read together with the other blood gas values. This test alone usually cannot provide a diagnosis, so more tests may be ordered if results are not typical.
belowRange: A lower reading may be associated with a problem in the lungs and breathing
It may be checked in people with breathing conditions or those receiving oxygen therapy
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
